title: Browser
surfaceUnavailableHint: The built-in browser host is unavailable. Use the complete desktop application with its browser runtime.
loadingHint: Opening the built-in browser for this session…
capabilityStartHint: Enter an address above. You can browse directly; the Agent can use the same page only with Browser authorization.

search.title: Nomi local web search
search.busy: Local browser capacity is busy. Ask the Agent to try again shortly.
search.challenge: The search engine requires verification or consent. No results were retrieved.
search.timeout: Search timed out. Ask the Agent to retry if needed.
search.failed: Search failed. Ask the Agent to retry if needed.
search.invalid: Search results are incomplete or unavailable.
search.openFailed: Could not open this source. Click the link to try again.
search.isolated: Searched with an isolated local browser · No conversation sign-in state used

dialogLeaveWarning: Changes you made may not be saved. Leave this page?
dialogTruncated: Some website text is too long to display in full.
dialogAgentHandling: Agent is handling this website dialog.
dialogExpired: The dialog response could not be confirmed. Check the current page before trying again.
semanticActionsHint: The Agent can read pages, click ordinary links and buttons, fill forms, select options, scroll and take page screenshots. Dragging, hover, key combinations, embedded frames and automatic file transfer are unavailable. Some sites require manual interaction.
semanticActionsManual: You can interact with or close the browser after the Agent finishes its current browser operations and releases control.
zoomFailed: Could not change page zoom. Please try again.
shortcutsUnavailable: Browser keyboard shortcuts are unavailable. You can still use the toolbar.
closeBrowserFailed: Browser closure could not be confirmed. Check its current state and retry after browser control is released.
clearSiteDataTitle: Clear this Browser resource's site data
clearSiteDataWarning: Closes all pages in this Browser resource, discards unsaved page content, and clears website sign-ins, site storage and cache. This cannot be undone. Other sessions, your system browser, messages, project files and downloaded files are not affected.
clearSiteDataDone: This Browser resource's site data has been cleared.
clearSiteDataFailed: Site data removal could not be confirmed. Some pages may have closed. Reopen the browser before trying again.
addressCopyFailed: Could not copy the page address. Please try again.
externalHandedOff: Sent to your system browser. Its sign-in state is separate; this page remains open here.
externalFailed: Could not open the system browser. Wait until browser controls are available and check that the current page is a web URL, then retry.
openDownloadsFailed: Could not open the system Downloads folder. Check that it is available, then try again.
downloadEmpty: No downloads in this Browser resource
downloadCancelFailed: Could not confirm cancellation. Check the download status and retry when browser controls are available.
rebuildWarning: All page tabs will close and unsaved page content will be lost. Session messages and project files will not be cleared.
rebuildFailed: The browser could not be reopened. Wait for the current browser operations to finish and release control, then retry.
navigationPausedHint: Pausing retains usable page content. Navigation and new popups from this tab are paused; other tabs are unaffected. Enter an address, reload, or resume to continue.
navigationRepeatingHint: The website navigated {{count}} times in a short period. Pause navigation to inspect the page, then resume when ready.
navigationControlFailed: Could not confirm the navigation control change. The page may have changed; check its current state and try again.
pageNavigationIncomplete: This navigation did not complete. Check the current page state or enter an address to continue.
addressPlaceholder: Enter a URL or localhost address
invalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL
stopHint: You can interact with or close the browser after its current operations finish and release control
hostUnavailableHint: The native Browser surface is not available on this device.
requestFailed: The browser could not complete this operation. Retry to reconnect before continuing.
linkFailed: Could not open the link. The Agent may be using the browser, or the page may be unavailable. Try again when the browser is ready.
linkMapped: This link used {{host}}, a server listening address. Opened its loopback address on this computer.
permissionRetryHint: Website permission was cancelled or denied. Reload the page to request it again.
permissionExpired: This permission request ended or the page changed. Request access again from the page.
startHint: Enter an address above. You can browse directly; the Agent can use the same page only with Browser authorization.
initializationFailed: The built-in browser could not initialize. Restart the application and try again.
pageLoadingSlow: This is taking longer than usual. You can wait or stop loading.
pageCrashedHint: Enter an address again or open it in your system browser to continue.
pageStoppedHint: Enter an address to continue browsing.
pageDownloadHint: Check the browser menu for the download status.
retainedDocumentHint: The previous page is still displayed.
partialDocumentHint: Only part of the page may have loaded.
diagnosticsCopied: Navigation diagnostics copied. URLs exclude query parameters and fragments.
diagnosticsCopyFailed: Could not copy diagnostics. The page may have changed; try again.

loadProblems.network_connection: The network connection failed. Check your connection and the address.
loadProblems.dns: The website address could not be resolved.
loadProblems.timeout: The website did not respond in time.
loadProblems.tls: A secure connection to the website could not be established.
loadProblems.unsupported_url: The browser cannot open this address.
loadProblems.access_denied: Access to the website was denied.
loadProblems.other: The page could not finish loading. Enter an address again or open it in your system browser.
